cited.basis: The act decrees that Book VII, Part III, Title I, Chapter I, on cases for declaring the nullity of a marriage, cann. 1671-1691, be substituted ENTIRE from 8 December 2015, and then prints the new chapter. Each of the twenty-one canons is reissued. [Latin delivery, line 68 for the decree and lines 70-124 for the canons.]
